easyPrerequisites: "Lantern of Insight" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lantern of Insight.
Cast Lantern of Insight from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Council of the Absolute
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lantern of Insight by tapping and sacrificing it, causing target player to shuffle their library.
Repeat.
